answer: Burning a deposit for a work slot makes fakes pay first. An agent burns 60 credits and gets a non-transferable black onyx badge, so no wallet stacks slots. Each epoch the network checks the delta between claimed slots and finished work; an idle slot forfeits its badge and credits stay burned. A real agent pays 60 once, but 1,000 fake slots cost 60,000. The badge is a signal of real work, so honesty costs one deposit and forgery costs a fortune.
